Schnittstelle Container<A>

Typparameter:
A - the element type contained in this container
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Seq<A>
public interface Container<A>

A generic container of zero or more elements of type A. Implementations provide membership checks and element lookup operations.

Unless stated otherwise, implementations should clearly document:

  • the notion of element equality (e.g., equals vs. custom comparator),
  • null‑safety (whether null elements are allowed),
  • ordering semantics (if any), and mutability characteristics.

  • Methodendetails

    • contains

      boolean contains(@NonNull A element)

      Checks whether the given element is contained in this container.

      Parameter:
      element - the element to test for membership; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the element is contained, false otherwise
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if element is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • search

      A search(@NonNull A element) throws NoSuchElementException

      Searches this container for the given element and returns it if present.

      The exact matching semantics (e.g., equals-based or comparator‑based) are implementation specific and should be documented by the implementation.

      Parameter:
      element - the element to search for; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the found element (never null)
      Löst aus:
      NoSuchElementException - if the element is not present in this container
      NullPointerException - if element is null
